root.name: King's Pawn Game: Philidor Gambit
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. d4 d6 3. dxe5 Bd7

overview: Black declines to recapture on e5 after 3.dxe5 and plays 3...Bd7, planning to meet exd6 with ...Bxd6 or ...Bxd6 and fast development. White is a pawn up and can keep it with accurate play. The line is rare and of doubtful value.

white_ideas.idea: Keep the extra pawn and defend e5

typical_structures.structure: White centre pawn on e5 attacked by d6 and Nc6

character.notes: Black plays for activity down a pawn.

gambit.notes: White keeps the pawn with exd6 Bxd6 or f4.

soundness.notes: Black has little compensation against careful play.

structure.notes: Tension around e5 and open lines.

sublines_that_differ.name: Philidor with 3...dxe5
sublines_that_differ.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. d4 d6 3. dxe5 dxe5
sublines_that_differ.how: queen trade, a calm and standard Philidor line

character.reason: Black risks a pawn for quick development.

gambit.reason: Black avoids the recapture on e5 and plays on a pawn down.

soundness.reason: Strong players think the compensation is thin.

level.reason: Dubious lines are not for beginners.

plans.reason: Black wants quick development in return for the pawn.
